title: Powers and duties of chief of police.
bodyText: The chief of police shall have the powers and duties as prescribed by law, the respective county charter, and as provided by this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§52D-3]  Powers and duties of chief of police.  The chief of police shall have the powers and duties as prescribed by law, the respective county charter, and as provided by this chapter. [L 1989, c 136, pt of §2]
